heading: Monday Night
text: Partly cloudy north; becoming mainly clear south. Lows in the mid to upper 20s, with some lower 30s near Lake Champlain, and some lower 20s northeast and in the Adirondacks. Northwest winds 5 to 10 mph, gusting to 20 mph.

heading: Tuesday
text: Mostly sunny south; variable clouds north. Valley highs from the mid 30s to around 40, some lower 30s northeast and in the Adirondacks. West to northwest winds 5 to 10 mph, gusting to 20 mph.

heading: Tuesday Night
text: A few evening clouds, then mainly clear. Lows from the mid teens to lower 20s. Winds becoming light and variable.
